ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $AB$ is the diameter of $\odot O$. If $\angle AOC=130^\circ$, what is the measure of $\angle D$ in degrees?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Draw AD, \\
since AB is the diameter of circle O, and $\angle$AOC $= 130^\circ$, \\
therefore, $\angle$BDA $= 90^\circ$, and $\angle$CDA $= 65^\circ$, \\
hence, $\angle$BDC $=\boxed{25^\circ}$.
